data.long_meaning: The name Jonell has roots in both Hebrew and Greek languages. In Hebrew, it is derived from the word 'Yonah,' which means 'dove.' In Greek, the name 'Jonas' means 'God's gift.' Thus, Jonell is a beautiful blend of these two meanings, conveying the idea of a graceful woman who is a divine gift from God. The name Jonell carries the meaning “Graceful, God's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jonell usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
